author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@aaronpk I am helping a functional glass artist collective move to an #indieweb model.

Currently installed have no website with no e-commerce solution.

Everything runs through Instagram, word of mouth, and PayPal.

I am thinking static web (page builder using whatever credit card PoS they have) and a micro.blog until Instagram takes away unofficial API.

Think the guillotine will drop soon?
